name: Myanmar
value: Airstrikes killed 15 on 1 Nov; Sittwe fighting
summary: Military airstrikes killed at least 15 civilians on 1 Nov, The Irrawaddy reports; fighting continues around Sittwe
state: Military aircraft bombed Kyauktaw, Mrauk-U, Pauktaw and Kyaukphyu townships on 1 Nov, killing at least 15 civilians and injuring 32, The Irrawaddy reported via Anadolu; the strikes hit homes and a maternity facility. A school in Loikaw township was bombed on 31 Oct, with three children reported killed. Fighting continues across Sittwe Township, the military's last northern Rakhine stronghold (BNI, 2 Nov). Searches on 8 Nov found no major city changing hands.
for_you: Civilians in Rakhine and Karenni states are most exposed, including those seeking health care. Air attacks on towns tend to drive further displacement. FCDO travel advice is the official reference for Myanmar.
rubric_hit: Watch: civil war at sustained intensity. Alert line not clearly crossed: no major city fell, and the 15 deaths on 1 Nov were spread across several townships.
